follow-up time: From 4-16 weeks to 28-42 weeks of pregnancy
exposure: HDP subtypes (preeclampsia, gestational hypertension, chronic hypertension)
outcome: Serum levels of total cholesterol, triglycerides, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, apolipoprotein A, B, and E, free fatty acids, and small and dense low-density lipoprotein cholesterol
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with HDP who underwent antenatal care and delivered at Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University between January 2018 and August 2022.
finding: Serum lipid levels changed significantly throughout pregnancy in women with HDP, with those experiencing preeclampsia exhibiting more pronounced changes compared to those with gestational hypertension or chronic hypertension.
